params.body:
The site showed which networks it reads, and how little each one adds: "11 platforms" under every trend (there are about eight platform families, so the number sits near its ceiling), and a build-up graph with a layer per network, Reddit among them, although Reddit is no longer read. This shows the breadth by kind.

## What changes

- **Evidence line** (`TrendCard::evidenceLine`): "69 signals, 34 sources", without the platform count added in #272. An old row without sources says its signals alone.
- **Build-up graph** ("When the signals landed"): `TrendCard::sparkByKind` adds the platform layers (social, Reddit, other) into one, Platforms, next to Web & press and Reports. It runs in `Reader::readingFor`, so the trend page, the API and the MCP tools all get kinds, and in the sparkline component for the trend cards.
- **"Read across N"** under the signal list: sources only; no platform count as a fallback.

Not changed: the platform line on the home page (copy from the brief) and the source name on each signal, which is the evidence itself and opens with the Sources ability.

## Tests

New `SparkByKindTest`: layers add up into one, the reading every door reads carries kinds, the legend uses no network colour, empty stays empty. `BreedteVanBewijsTest`, `EvidenceKindsTest` and `MomentumInWordsTest` follow the shorter line. The full suite passes apart from BuildStampTest, which fails in any worktree.

params.title: Show evidence by kind, not by network
